These passive skills improve your character's base stats. You can unlock only one passive skill per row. The only thing required to unlock these passive skills is character level. Glitches in some VFX animations have been fixed. That's all for this update for now. If you'd like to support me, don't forget to check out the demo and add the game to your wishlist. Thank you. Sincerely, Musa GUNGOR

Hashasin's first skill now has a much shorter cooldown, so I hope this makes the character more playable. A minor visual glitch in the drop indicators inside the dungeon has been fixed. events.summary: Hello, Dear Grind Lords, With this quick update : The Baby Dragon has been added to the Premium Store. The Baby Dragon can be leveled up to level 99. Every time the Baby Dragon levels up, it gains a +1 bonus to all its stats (Except Critical Hit). The Baby Dragon restores its stats from Curse Harm once every 10 levels and resets the Curse Harm counter. The baby dragon gains EXP in both the active dungeon and the AFK dungeon. events.title: Lord of the Grind - Demo Quick Update v2
events.summary: Hello, Dear Grind Lords, In today's quick update, I added a functional key-binding system to the game. You'll now be able to control your skill hotkeys, as well as the character menu, inventory menu, and other menus found in dungeon and town, more easily by assigning keys to them. That's all for this update, thank you for your supports. Sincerely, Musa GUNGOR
